title: Retained import foundation (preview)
items: An opt-in server preview retains acquired Vortex analysis proxies and completed import evidence outside temporary download storage. It is off by default.
Retained imports include owner-checked source references. Full automatic board attachment and paginated frame delivery are not part of this preview.
No local Qwen model or all-user model-default migration is enabled by this update. Existing model selections remain unchanged.
Add Vortex media from Add to board or the selected module’s Files tab. Paste a URL, Find, then Apply.
Vision automatically uses lightweight video with snapshots and transcription, or audio for music and audio-only links.
Accepted imports continue processing on FUPCJ Server while the page is closed. Reopen the saved project to receive the result.
A normal Balanced video or default M4A audio copy appears quietly in the same account’s Vortex history.
Update FUPCJ Server with the latest Setup-Vision-PC.ps1 -Action Update, then refresh Vision. Existing Vortex engines and Docker services do not need reinstalling.
The API balance now shows a precise remaining percentage and refreshes every second while open.
Live input and output estimates reconcile with reported model usage, caching, reasoning and tool costs.
Terra and the other built-in models now have verified prices in the funding catalog.
